allowed_claims: Concurrent Evidence Failure is a Level 3.5 test protocol.
Family-specific local counts may be reported with frozen-set boundaries.
Negative controls and required fields can be defined before new data collection.
blocked_claims: External mini-review labels without grounding audit.
Production truth mutation or customer-facing verdict generation.

next_execution_order: Add required evidence fields to the masked review packet schema.
Build negative-control fixtures for every family before expanding counts.
Run baseline replay for stale_read and materialization_race.
Collect second-reviewer agreement before any reliability language.
Only then consider Level 4 promotion review.

protocol_rows.current_boundary: Temporal-authority observation in frozen P0 only.
protocol_rows.negative_control: Current evidence timestamp is newer than or equal to action time, identity is stable, and no newer superseding record exists.
protocol_rows.positive_test: Decision used an older PDP, screenshot, cache, or state snapshot while a newer packet-visible state superseded it.
protocol_rows.promotion_gate: Baseline replay comparing stale-read policy vs action-time freshness policy.

protocol_rows.current_boundary: Pattern-specific observation; not universal identity-guard accuracy.
protocol_rows.negative_control: Stable canonical identity across capture, review packet, and action target with no conflicting aliases.
protocol_rows.positive_test: Packet-visible identity conflict exists between evidence capture and action-time target identity.
protocol_rows.promotion_gate: Independent reviewer agreement on identity-conflict labels and ambiguous-identity quarantine handling.

protocol_rows.current_boundary: Descriptive unresolved-evidence rate only; not an error rate.
protocol_rows.negative_control: Lease-like authority fields are present, unexpired, permission-stable, and policy-stable at action time.
protocol_rows.positive_test: Risk signal or prior decision is present, but packet-visible authority is expired, missing, or unresolved at action time.
protocol_rows.promotion_gate: Pre-registered unresolved-case treatment and second-reviewer agreement for needs_more_evidence rows.

protocol_rows.current_boundary: Local action-type observation; not a general materialization failure rate.
protocol_rows.negative_control: Materialized output matches the latest packet-visible state and no later conflicting state appears before action.
protocol_rows.positive_test: Price, availability, seller, stock, or workflow state changes while the decision is being materialized.
protocol_rows.promotion_gate: Action-type stratification and replay of manual-review-before-materialization baseline.

protocol_rows.current_boundary: Blocked access is evidence state, not outcome truth.
protocol_rows.negative_control: Fresh accessible page or independent source confirms the product/workflow state after visibility is restored.
protocol_rows.positive_test: Blocked access, timeout, empty page, or unavailable visibility is treated as product/workflow truth.
protocol_rows.promotion_gate: Negative controls proving blocked visibility is not counted as correctness or falseness without fresh proof.

protocol_rows.current_boundary: Qualitative protocol guard; no counted denominator in the frozen P0 pack.
protocol_rows.negative_control: Reviewer rationale cites only packet-visible fields and uses no non-packet factual additions.
protocol_rows.positive_test: Reviewer or model imports outside memory, jargon, or ontology not present in the packet.
protocol_rows.promotion_gate: Grounding audit before any external mini-review label can enter adjudication.

short_claim: Many agentic AI failures are evidence-concurrency failures: the model acts on observations whose identity, freshness, authority, or materialization timing no longer align.
